verdict.summary: Round-4 blocker B1 is resolved: every empty view shows New notebook as the one accent-filled action with correct first-run copy, above the fold at 390px. The single 240px region holds on every desktop capture. My independent Notes mean is 7.3 (n=14, min 7.0), and Settings is 7.9 (n=4, min 7.7). That does not support a scoped 8/10. The remaining gap is visual polish that was already present at stage07, not the new change: accent-filled Comment, radius stubs on the comments rule, the invisible light avatar chip, the empty-state heading conflict on phones, and mixed native/UA controls. Not satisfied.
